free_tier.stated: No free tier. FR 256 MB NAT (NAT KVM group) is USD 5.99 billed annually: 1 vCPU, 256 MB, 5 GB NVMe, unmetered bandwidth at 1 Gbps, NAT IPv4 with 20 usable ports, 1 dedicated IPv6.
free_tier.notes: Most other 256MB plans in the group are USD 6.99 with 800 GB.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a NAT VPS, not an object store

egress.terms: Unmetered bandwidth at 1 Gbps; no fair-use figure stated on the page read.

chaining: An unmetered 1 Gbps NAT IPv4 KVM box with a dedicated IPv6: IPv6 inbound needs no forwarded port; IPv4 inbound is limited to 20 usable ports and UDP forwarding is not stated.

limits.value: 1 Gbps port; NAT IPv4 with 20 usable ports

binding_note: The 20 NAT ports are the cap on inbound IPv4; the plan states no volume cap.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: behind a sign-up. The register page read lists no fields; the refund policy requires a ticket in a client area.

reliability_note: The page prints 'Unmetered' with no fair-use figure; the vendor's refund policy gives a 72-hour window.
confidence_note: Plan, price and bandwidth are quoted from the vendor's group page as served.

evidence.proved: the FR 256 MB NAT plan is listed in the NAT KVM group
the price of the FR 256 MB NAT plan block is USD 5.99, billed annually
